mentions.name: Klugli
mentions.description: Educational app for German primary school children in grades 1-4. Parents create accounts and kids log in with simple codes to work through curriculum-aligned Math and German exercises. Built with Elixir, Phoenix, Ash, and LiveView, with the content mapped directly to the German school curriculum.
mentions.problem: Creating learning content that actually maps to the German school curriculum rather than generic "educational" fluff.
mentions.audience: German primary school kids in grades 1-4 and their parents, who set up the accounts
mentions.source_excerpt:
